changes: Extended: explicitly omit 4 g unavailable curry leaves without aromatic-equivalence claim; retain mustard 2 g and ginger 18 g in tempering. One sixteenth of total oil goes into retained tempering, remaining fifteen sixteenths into unmeasured shallow-fry process.

New 20 ml already reviewed sour tamarind concentrate instead of 30 g generic tamarind paste, no density conversion. Preserve all pitted dates/coriander/lime; simmer frozen coriander at least three minutes and serve entire chutney. Keep same potato-drain and shallow-fry losses with step indices shifted by insertion.

New 416 g soft Swedish sesame burger-bun version, not pav identity. Weigh peeled potato; separate simmer/drain/drying; boil frozen garlic then dry it for chutney. Two fritters per portion, all batter served, shallow-fry oil uptake unknown, process-water amounts scale.
recipes.content_review: Utökad vada pav behåller standardens senapsfrö/ingefära och separata sötsyrliga dadelchutney. Samma öppna bröd-/utan-currybladsanpassning som steg 54. Det redan granskade tamarindkoncentratet i ml används som egen ny dos 20 ml i stället för 30 g pasta; ingen ny produktkälla, densitet eller gram/ml-konvertering. Alla 60 g urkärnade dadlar, 15 g koriander och 25 ml limejuice behålls; fryst koriander genomkokas i chutneyn.
